purpose: Record targeted checks against official or primary records without treating title matching as complete speaker/event independence.
claim_boundary: These checks may corroborate a speaker, topic or public record. They do not verify that a particular upload is the same event, that captions are exact, or that a communication pattern causes an audience outcome.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | S. JAISHANKAR: India's Five Pledges (English Subtitles)
checks.finding: The UN record identifies Subrahmanyam Jaishankar speaking for India and contains the five-pledges framing and related wording.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | JUSTIN TRUDEAU: We’re All the Same (English Subtitles)
checks.official_source_title: Canada.ca: Address by Minister Dion at the High-Level Panel on Inclusion and Diversity
checks.finding: The official Canada page attributes public inclusion language to Prime Minister Justin Trudeau, but it does not establish that this specific upload, date, venue or sampled caption is the same event.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | ELON MUSK: The Power of Solar Energy (English Subtitles)
checks.finding: Tesla's primary site attributes a 2016 solar-power plan to Elon Musk and corroborates the speaker/topic association, but not the English Speeches upload, venue or sampled timestamp.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | JACK MA ALIBABA: We Never Give Up (English Subtitles)
checks.official_source_title: Alibaba Group Announces Executive Chairman Succession Plan
checks.finding: Alibaba's primary corporate page identifies Jack Ma and preserves his first-person institutional voice, but it does not corroborate the sampled speech, venue or timestamp.

checks.official_source_title: Prime Minister Carney delivers remarks at the Citadelle of Québec
checks.finding: The official Prime Minister of Canada page identifies Mark Carney and contains closely related future-building language, but it does not establish that this is the same event or sampled upload.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | MELANIA TRUMP: A Public Denial (English Subtitles)
checks.official_source_title: United Nations transcript: Reasserting international legal protections for children in armed conflict
checks.finding: The UN transcript references Melania Trump presiding over a Security Council event, but does not corroborate this upload, its date, its topic or the sampled caption.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | EMINEM & 50 CENT: Walk of Fame Speech (English Subtitles)
checks.official_source_title: Hollywood Walk of Fame: Curtis ‘50 Cent’ Jackson
checks.finding: The Hollywood Chamber page records the January 30, 2020 star ceremony and lists Eminem among the celebrity speakers, corroborating the event association while leaving the English Speeches edit and exact caption timing unverified.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | OPRAH WINFREY: Learn From Every Mistake (English Subtitles)
checks.finding: Harvard's as-delivered account identifies Oprah Winfrey's May 30, 2013 Harvard commencement address and preserves the sampled Harvard framing and wording. It does not establish that the English Speeches edit, caption timing or every reused packet occurrence is identical to the official record.

checks.sampled_title: ENGLISH SPEECH | JENNIFER COOLIDGE: Find Your Own Path (English Subtitles)
checks.official_source_title: Washington University: Coolidge shares message of self-acceptance at WashU Commencement
checks.finding: Washington University's official account identifies Jennifer Coolidge's May 13, 2024 commencement address at Francis Olympic Field and describes her personal journey. It does not establish that the English Speeches edit, caption timing or sampled wording is identical to the official event record.

next_action: Check the remaining packet sources against primary event records and record date, venue, speaker and exact-clip correspondence before changing packet independence status.
